title: Annadata Sukhibhava - PM KISAN Guidelines
publisher: Department of Agriculture, Government of Andhra Pradesh & Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, GoI
notes: Official guidelines for AP annual farmer assistance of Rs 20000 (Rs 6000 PM-KISAN central + Rs 14000 AP state top-up). Transitioning and expanded from erstwhile Rythu Bharosa.

publisher: Department of Agriculture, Government of Andhra Pradesh & Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, GoI
notes: Comprehensive yield and weather-based crop insurance. State government covers farmer share of premium for notified crops mapped through e-Crop/e-Panta.

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme Rules
publisher: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India & RBI
notes: Concessional institutional short-term production credit up to Rs 3 lakh at 7 percent nominal interest with 3 percent prompt repayment subvention (effective 4 percent).

title: Soil Health Card & Polam Badi Program
publisher: Department of Agriculture, Government of Andhra Pradesh
notes: Field-level soil test nutrient status reports and Rythu Bharosa Kendra (RBK) weekly farmer field training on integrated nutrient and pest management.

title: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva Scheme (Aarogyasri)
publisher: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva Trust, Health Medical & Family Welfare Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
notes: Flagship cashless healthcare coverage up to Rs 25 Lakh per family per year across 3257+ procedures in empaneled network hospitals for BPL Rice Card holders. Transitioning from Dr. YSR Aarogyasri.

title: 104 Mobile Medical Units & 108 Emergency Medical Services
publisher: Health, Medical & Family Welfare Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
notes: Free 24x7 emergency medical response (108) and monthly scheduled gram panchayat mobile medical clinic visits (104) providing screening and chronic disease drug refills.

title: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY Convergence in Andhra Pradesh
publisher: National Health Authority (NHA), GoI & Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva Trust, GoAP
notes: State-national co-branded convergence providing portable secondary and tertiary care hospitalization coverage up to Rs 5 Lakh per family.

publisher: Department of School Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh
notes: Annual educational grant of Rs 15000 per student (Rs 13000 to mother DBT, Rs 2000 school maintenance) for Classes 1-12 with 75 percent attendance. Transitioning from erstwhile Jagananna Amma Vodi.

publisher: Social Welfare & Higher Education Departments, Government of Andhra Pradesh
notes: Full tuition fee reimbursement (RTF) and annual maintenance/hostel grant of Rs 10000-20000 (MTF) for eligible post-matric students whose family income is <= Rs 2.5 Lakh.

title: Samagra Shiksha Andhra Pradesh & Mid-Day Meal (PM POSHAN)
publisher: Department of School Education, GoAP & Ministry of Education, GoI
notes: Universal school education assistance providing free bilingual textbooks, uniforms, and daily fortified hot cooked mid-day meals in government and aided schools.

publisher: Society for Elimination of Rural Poverty (SERP), PR & RD Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
notes: Monthly social security pensions: Rs 4000/month for Old Age Persons (60+), Widows, Weavers; Rs 6000/month for PwD; Rs 10000/month for severe chronic illness. Transitioning from erstwhile YSR Pension Kanuka.

publisher: Department of GVWV & VSWS, Government of Andhra Pradesh
notes: Decentralized village and ward secretariat service centers delivering 540+ public services under defined Citizens' Charter SLAs (majority within 72 hours).

title: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS - AP)
publisher: Department of Rural Development, Government of Andhra Pradesh & MoRD, GoI
notes: Statutory guarantee of at least 100 days of wage employment per financial year for rural households volunteering for unskilled manual labor.

title: Pedalandariki Illu / APSHCL Housing Programme
publisher: Andhra Pradesh State Housing Corporation Limited, GoAP & MoHUA, GoI
notes: Free house site pattas in the name of female family head and subsidized financial assistance for pucca housing construction for homeless BPL families.
